summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency source for libsignal in @chatunity/baileys
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` with the value `github:chatunitycenter/libsignal-node`, an off-registry GitHub source with no commit SHA, tag, or branch pin. `npm install` of @chatunity/baileys resolves this dependency to whatever HEAD of chatunitycenter/libsignal-node currently contains and runs any lifecycle scripts inside it, with no integrity verification. The dependency source is off-registry (a git reference rather than a registry version range) and the reference is fully mutable — HEAD at any future install can differ arbitrarily from what was tested at publish time. This resolution path executes on every default install and cannot be avoided while depending on this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
